findings.title: Cached denials prevent newly granted access from reaching the database
findings.body: This short-circuits every check with a cached denial before checking current permissions. If a resource was denied and then created or granted to the user, subsequent checks for the same namespace, action, name, and folder continue to return false until the denial entry expires (30 seconds), even though the database now grants access. This undermines the fresh-permission fallback intended to let creators access newly created resources.
